name: SECTIONS_OF_THIS_ROAD_FROST_ICE_SNOW_YELLOW_LONG
legend: SECTIONS OF THIS ROAD ARE SUBJECT TO FROST ICE SNOW DRIVE WITH CARE
notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet G/10/649 'Frost ice & snow warning sign type 3' (2002, rev A 2013), Panel A: 2100 x 900, black legend on Class 1 yellow, no border drawn, corner radius not stated (measured about 75). Lines 1-2 120 Series D '50% spacing', lines 3-4 140 Series E '60% spacing'; vertical 75/120/60/120/100/140/70/140/75. Widths 112/706/90/178/80/323/100/398/113, 397/297/90/665/80/171/400, 130/608/95/478/105/556/128, 196/643/100/306/100/575/180: the ICE (478) and WITH (306) figures cannot be right for 140 E (about 310 and 460) and are not checked. Panel A is hinged along the centreline to show an optional safety message (options 1-3 on the sheet, with logos: not generated) and is installed 150 above Panel B.
